profile_text.body:
UiPath is a publicly traded enterprise software company (NYSE: PATH, CIK 0001734722) that describes itself as providing a platform for business orchestration and automation. Its core offering, the UiPath Platform, is positioned around combining AI agents, robots, and human workers to deliver automated workflows at enterprise scale. The company emphasizes use cases across industries including insurance, government, finance, and professional services.

UiPath's primary AI product is UiPath AI, which the site tracks as an RPA and AI platform incorporating document understanding, process mining, and enterprise automation governance. The company's website highlights customer outcomes across several named organizations: Johnson Controls, which it says saved $18 million and 900,000 hours by automating invoice processing; Uber, described as on pace to save $22 million through automation; VITAL, which used UiPath to serve 450% more agencies while saving 15,000 work hours; TQL, which deployed automation to assist with 33,000 daily decisions; dentsu, saving more than 125,000 hours; and Generali and Xerox, cited in broader automation case studies. The site also references a UiPath Bridge program supporting NYPCC in delivering mental health services to underserved communities.

The held facts confirm UiPath is a for-profit public company verified as of August 2026, with no litigation or MCP server entries currently on record at theworldofai.org.
